run_pixio_pretraining: run the Pixio pre-training script with argparse CLI to train a vision transformer model on ImageNet or WebDataset
run_distributed_training: run distributed multi-GPU training for Pixio with configurable batch size, learning rate, and gradient accumulation
run_resumed_training: resume Pixio pre-training from a saved checkpoint with the --resume flag and --start_epoch
run_webdataset_training: run Pixio pre-training on WebDataset with tar-based image data and epoch-based shuffling
run_imagenet_pretraining: run Pixio pre-training on ImageNet with configurable masking ratio, mask grid, and class tokens
